Name: Jen's Beach Farm
Author: jenf1
Description:
[size=3][b]This mod is only available here at Nexus Mods! If you see it anywhere else, it has been uploaded without my permission and should be taken down immediately![/b][/size]

[size=5]Features:[/size]

- A small-ish custom beach farm that doesn't replace any default farm.
- Ocean Panorama that changes during the day and night.
- Forage that spawns on the grass and the beach
- All tiles are tillable, beach tiles allows sprinklers
- Beach area allows you to catch ocean fish. Pond area with the waterfall allows you to catch river fish.
- Farmhouse interior is the same as the default beach farm.

- Farm Cave is hidden behind the waterfall.

[size=5]Config Options:[/size]

Install the mod and run the game using SMAPI at least once in order to generate a config.json file.

- [b]Starter Gift[/b]: Choose which type of gift you'd like to receive upon starting a new save. Defaults Farmer
[list]
[*]﻿Default: 15 Parsnip Seeds
[*]Farmer: 10 Parsnip Seeds and 1 Quality Sprinkler
[*]Fisher: 3 Crab Pots and 20 Bait
[*]Rancher: 20 Hay and 10 Blue Grass Starters
[*]Miner: 1 Furnace, 10 Bombs, and 1 Miner's Treat
[*]Forager: 10 Carrot Seeds and 1 Mushroom Log﻿
[/list]- [b]Ocean Ambience[/b]: Overrides the background music on the farm with the ocean ambience. (True, False) Defaults False

[size=5]A Few Closing Notes:[/size]

- When fishing for the first time, the first fish you catch will be a Sunfish. The rest should be appropriate to their area. I don't know how to fix this.
- There may be some cosmetic imperfections depending upon which recolor mod you use. This is out of my control and I will fix what I can, but I can't account for every single one.

[size=5]Install:[/size]

- Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3231]Farm Type Manager[/url].
- Copy Jen's Beach Farm into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder
- Load the game using SMAPI and enjoy!

[size=5]Future Plans:[/size]

- Make the panorama more dynamic, accounting for sunrise, sunset, and weather.
